اغتربن (form VIII)
# اِغْتَرَبْنَ (iḡtarabna) /iɣ.ta.rab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
# اُغْتُرِبْنَ (uḡturibna) /uɣ.tu.rib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
# اِغْتَرِبْنَ (iḡtaribna) /iɣ.ta.rib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
